about_the_game:
Digital version of a board game that doesn't exist.

Skeleton Hotel : Season 10 is a dice-based, single-player survival board game with a strong emphasis on inventory management and replayability—built on a Deepfold Narrative Axis ™

Evermore Network Division
& Rosenberg Interactive Productions presents

( Starring Detective Whoopsy )

- - -

Directive

Greetings, Old Sport!

You seem like a fine and capable citizen, so congratulations! You’ve won! Now, be so kind and open that nice, big door. (...) Yeah, the one behind you. (...) That’s the exit. Just open it.

That’s your goal. Simple, right?

- - -

Deepfold Narrative Axis ™ : The layers of madness

The surface plot of Skeleton Hotel : Season 10 may be one of the simplest, shortest stories ever. But the overarching narrative and lore of Skeleton Hotel? Absolute rabbit-hole madness, for only the most dedicated hardcore theorycrafters. This is Deepfold Narrative Axis ™ in a nutshell : a recursive framework that structures a pre-established story and lore, where elements—from simple events to broader concepts—are deliberately designed to function across multiple layers of interpretation.

- - -

Is Season 10 understandable on its own?

Skeleton Hotel : Season 10 stands on its own as a hyper-compact story, packed with clear nods and extremely well-hidden hints that invite curiosity. It also delivers answers ( some tied to questions you haven’t realized yet ) while laying down a wealth of clues that seamlessly weave into the pre-established story and lore of Skeleton Hotel.

- - -

Skeleton Hotel : Season 10 is for you if :

- You like dice and card-based board games.
- You enjoy single-player experiences.
- You appreciate hyper-compact, fast-paced stories.
- You relish lore and theory-crafting.
- You love inventory management.
- Replayability is an important factor for you.
- You don't just finish games; you complete them.

- - -

How long is Skeleton Hotel : Season 10?

Main story ( depending on your OCD level ) :
~45–90 minutes per round

Completionist:
~6 hours

- - -

High replayability with tons of unlockables!

Collect crazy character cards, unlock hidden game modes, discover exciting gameplay modifiers, battle secret encounters, reveal cryptic messages, and more! The hotel holds many secrets. Who knows how many?

- - -

Hey! What about the other seasons?

The world of Skeleton Hotel is introduced with Season 10 : The Anniversary Incident, followed by its direct continuation, Season 11 : Deadly Last Challenge. Below, you’ll find the complete season lineup, offering additional insights and hints from the pre-established story and lore of Skeleton Hotel.

Season 01 ( ??????????? ) - The Door of Secrets
Season 02 ( ??????????? ) - Twilight Visions
Season 03 ( ??????????? ) - Rise of Shadows
Season 04 ( ??????????? ) - Masks of the Board
Season 05 ( ??????????? ) - Through the Scratch Rift
Season 06 ( ??????????? ) - Bloodmoon Revenge
Season 07 ( ??????????? ) - The Heralds of Madness
Season 08 ( ??????????? ) - The Abstract Hunter
Season 09 ( ??????????? ) - The Cursed Beyond

Season 10 ( Board Game ) - The Anniversary Incident
Season 11 ( Board Game ) - Deadly Last Challenge

?????????? ( ??????????? ) - Fate of Evermore

- - -

What’s the deal with the release order?

The seasons’ release order may seem unorthodox, but worry not. Skeleton Hotel’s narrative was deliberately designed so that Season 10 itself contains more than enough clues to piece together its core story and lore, even if some of those clues are extremely subtle or vague.

- - -

Some characters may be considered spooky or wild.

short_description: Skeleton Hotel : Season 10 is a single-player survival board game with a strong emphasis on inventory management and replayability — featuring a hyper-compact, lore-rich story mode, super-crazy characters, obtainable S+ ranks, hidden unlockables, and more... Can you uncover all its secrets?
